In [[3643 BBY]], the [[Death's Claw]] pirate organization undertook an '''attack''' on the research expedition led by Master [[Cin Tykan]]. Most of the expedition was killed, with the exception of [[Astromech droid/Legends|astromech droid]] [[T8-C3]] and an advance group of researchers taken away by Tykan before the attack.
